community-group-buying-finance-settlement 1.0.0

- Initial release covering full financial settlement processes for community group buying platforms.
- Includes detailed models for platform profit, group leader commission calculation, supplier purchase settlement, cash flow management, and tax compliance.
- Provides industry benchmarks, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and risk management frameworks.
- Designed for financial managers and operations leaders to achieve clear, standardized financial operations.
- Supports decision-making and compliance with up-to-date (2024) tax regulations and industry practices.
